text: Which story did you love to hear as a child, and who told it?
What did the house you grew up in look, sound and smell like?
Which saying did your elders repeat most, and what did they mean by it?
Which dish takes you straight back home, and who made it best?
Find an old photograph. Who is in it, and what was happening just outside the frame?
What did a normal day look like when you were ten?
What do you do when you feel worried? What has always calmed you?
Who was your closest friend when you were young, and what did you get up to?
What is the best advice anyone ever gave you?
How did our family celebrate the most important festival of the year?
Which photograph of our family do you treasure most, and why?
What did your parents do for a living, and what were they like at work?
What helped you through the hardest year of your life?
What songs were sung at home, at weddings or at festivals?
What took you longest to learn about people?
What were you told about our family name, or our village?
What do you hope your grandchildren never lose?
What was school like for you? Which teacher do you remember?
How did you find courage when you were frightened?
Why did our family move, and what did they bring with them?
Which words or sayings did your elders use that people don't say any more?
Tell me about the happiest day you remember with the whole family together.
How did you meet your husband or wife? Or the person who mattered most to you?
What reminds you who you are when you doubt yourself?
Was there a ritual our family never skipped? Why did it matter?
What does it mean to you to live a good life?
What games did you play as a child, and what were the rules?
What would you like to tell a grandchild on the day they leave home?
Which grandparent do you remember best, and what were they like?
How do you stay kind when the world feels unkind?
Describe a journey you made that you will never forget.
What is something you were wrong about, and how did you find out?
What did you want to become when you grew up?
What do you do on a day when everything feels uncertain?
What changed most in the place you grew up during your lifetime?
Which proverb do you think everyone should know?
Tell me about a meal you shared that you still think about.
What was the bravest thing you ever did?
What do you want them to know about you that nobody else will remember?
Who did you turn to when you needed help, and what did they say?
What were the stories or legends about our region that you heard as a child?
What is the secret to staying close as a family?
Which object in your home carries the most memories? Tell me its story.
What work are you proudest of in your life?
How did you keep going when something you hoped for didn't happen?
What should every young person know about money, work and time?
What did you learn from your mother? And from your father?
What would you tell them about being human?
Which festival or celebration with the family do you remember most clearly?
If you could live one year of your life again, which would it be and why?
What gives you peace now?
Is there anything you have always wanted to say to the family, but never have?
